newsitem.title: POLAND: Taxpayers owe Polish budget PLN 2 bln -audit.
newsitem.headline: Taxpayers owe Polish budget PLN 2 bln -audit.

text.p: Taxpayers owe the Polish budget 1.997 billion zlotys in unpaid taxes for the first half of this year, 25 percent more than in the same period of 1995, an audit by Poland's tax offices showed.
Deputy Finance Minister Jan Kubik, who presented the report, told a news conference on Wednesday that more than half of the tax irregularities concerned the value added and excise tax.
He said, however, that taxpayers appealed the tax offices' audit results in almost 90 percent of the cases.
